items.brief: HKMA and Swift to explore tokenized deposits for cross-border bank payments
items.why: Tests linking tokenized deposits to cross-border settlement infrastructure.

items.brief: DBS, JPMorgan launch instant tokenized deposit transfers between US and Singapore
items.why: Shows tokenized deposits moving between banks across borders in production.

items.brief: South Korean fintech Toss to launch in-app non-custodial crypto wallet
items.why: Fintech expansion into self-custody and stablecoin payments signals tokenization use.

items.brief: DBS, JPMorgan's Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
items.why: Round-the-clock tokenized deposit transfers show always-on settlement potential.

items.brief: JPMorgan and DBS let clients move dollars across borders on weekends
items.why: Tokenized dollar deposits enable cross-border settlement outside banking hours.

items.brief: UK, Singapore, Thailand central banks test cross-border FX settlement
items.why: Central bank tests link blockchain and conventional settlement for FX tokenization.
